archetypes.name: snapshot-parity
archetypes.rationale: Checks that the proposed carryover predicate exactly matches the existing manifest-builder snapshot semantics and cannot diverge.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the plan truly aligns the dirty-tree guard with the existing pre-coder snapshot exclusion used by the manifest builder. Look for missing preconditions around pre-coder-head.txt, pre-coder-tracked-paths.txt, pre_coder_path_diff_file, and git diff comparison behavior that could make the two paths classify the same file differently. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: round-commit-contract
archetypes.rationale: Focuses on whether the proposed change preserves round-mode commit ownership, staging, and failure contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan against the round-mode commit path to verify that carryover dirt remains unstaged and uncommitted while coder delta paths are still staged and committed as before. Check whether the warning-only exclusion conflicts with documented CODER_STATUS, return-code, or manifest contracts in the script and markdown docs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: regression-harness
archetypes.rationale: Targets test-plan holes in the sed-extracted shell harness and its positive and negative controls.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine whether the proposed regression test can actually exercise the extracted functions in isolation with all required helper definitions and shell options. Look for fixture gaps around tracked versus untracked dirt, snapshot filenames, staged changes, missing larch_err stubs, and preserving the legacy single-argument guard behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
